description: This script generates and compiles an Android native test APK, including copying template files, replacing placeholders, copying native libraries, and building with ant.

classes.name: NativeTestApkGenerator
classes.description: A class to generate a native test APK source tree, replace placeholders, copy libraries, and compile the APK.

methods.name: _LibraryRoot
methods.description: Returns a root name for a shared library, used for placeholder replacement.

methods.name: _CopyTemplateFilesAndClearDir
methods.description: Copies necessary template files to the output directory, clearing it beforehand.

methods.name: _ReplaceStrings
methods.description: Replaces 'replaceme' placeholders in files with the library root name.

methods.name: _CopyLibrary
methods.description: Copies the native shared library into the APK source tree, stripping it if necessary.

methods.name: CreateBundle
methods.description: Creates the APK source bundle by copying files, replacing placeholders, and copying libraries.

methods.name: Compile
methods.description: Builds the APK using ant with specified arguments.
